name: gavet
description: Gavet - PWA offline-first para gerenciamento de garantias, notas fiscais e assinaturas

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
